purpose: Validate that the framework can onboard a second AI business without copying configuration or data from another tenant.

identityBoundary.requiredBeforeActivation: A real tenant must provide its own brand tokens. knownForeignBrandTokens may hold a non-production isolation-test sentinel for negative tests; no real foreign-tenant identity token is required.

crossTenantRules: No other tenant brand, ProductTruth, source, asset, destination, credential, approval or receipt may be read or reused.
Only approved de-identified aggregate LearningExport records may be compared across tenants.
A shared database plus a tenant_id column is not accepted for this pilot.
